2609.02519.title: Spectral Initialization and Scheduled Graph Smoothness for Uncertain Knowledge Graph Completion
2609.02519.paper_summary: Uncertain knowledge graphs (UKGs) extend knowledge graphs by assigning each triple a continuous confidence score. Since most possible triples lack observed confidences, recent methods rely on semi-supervised learning to generate pseudo-labels. These methods initialize entity embeddings without using the confidence-weighted graph, discarding its global community and hub structure. We introduce QUEST, which adds no trainable parameters to the standard confidence-distribution learning pipeline. First, QUEST initializes entity embeddings using the smallest non-trivial eigenvectors of the confidence-weighted graph Laplacian, incorporating community and hub structure before training. Second, QUEST applies an unbiased mini-batch Dirichlet energy regularizer to enforce early-stage structural consistency. On two UKG datasets, QUEST improves confidence prediction and link prediction on six of eight metric-dataset pairs over prior methods and matches the previous best on the remaining two, while removing the instability spike observed on dense graphs. These results indicate that spectral structural priors combined with a graph Dirichlet energy regularizer improve accuracy, training stability, and checkpoint reliability in UKG completion.
2609.02519.paper_summary_zh: 不確定知識圖譜（UKGs）通過為每個三元組分配連續的置信度分數來擴展知識圖譜。由於大多數可能的三元組缺乏觀察到的置信度，最近的方法依賴於半監督學習來生成偽標籤。這些方法在初始化實體嵌入時不使用置信度加權圖，從而丟棄其全局社群和樞紐結構。我們介紹了QUEST，它在標準的置信度分佈學習管道中不添加任何可訓練的參數。首先，QUEST使用置信度加權圖拉普拉斯算子的最小非平凡特徵向量來初始化實體嵌入，在訓練之前納入社群和樞紐結構。其次，QUEST應用無偏的小批量Dirichlet能量正則化器，以強制執行早期階段的結構一致性。在兩個UKG數據集上，QUEST在八個指標-數據集對中的六個上改善了置信度預測和連結預測，並在其餘兩個上與之前的最佳結果持平，同時消除了在密集圖中觀察到的不穩定峰值。這些結果表明，結合光譜結構先驗和圖Dirichlet能量正則化器可以提高UKG補全的準確性、訓練穩定性和檢查點可靠性。
